      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Alcohol_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Alcohol_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Ready_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverToRoom</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Pending_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Pending_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OtherOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitGuestAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Billed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" name="Room service called">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Msg_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Work_Split" name="Start kitchen, sommelier and cart work"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" name="Order includes wine or other alcoholic beverage?" default="Flow_NoAlcohol"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWine" name="Fetch wine and prepare other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge" name="Alcohol handling done"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart (tablecloth and silverware)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Join" name="Food, wine and cart ready"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverToRoom" name="Deliver order to guest room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Pending_Merge" name="Waiter at room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Pending_Split" name="Waiter has another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_DebitNow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OtherOrder" name="Prepare or deliver other order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Debit guest account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Billed" name="Guest account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitTicket" targetRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_GiveOrderToSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignOrderToWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_Work_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_Work_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Work_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_Work_Split" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_Work_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Yes (about 80% of orders)" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" targetRef="Task_FetchWine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">includesAlcoholicBeverage == true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Alcohol_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Task_DeliverToRoom"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_DeliverToRoom" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_Pending_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Pending_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Pending_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" name="Yes (postpone billing)" sourceRef="Gateway_Pending_Split" targetRef="Task_OtherOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">hasAnotherOrderPending == true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DebitNow" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Pending_Split" targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_OtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_Pending_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_Billed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
